title: Many AI Analysts, One Dataset: Navigating the Agentic Data Science Multiverse

bias_targets.methodology: Steering AI data analysts using different system prompt personas (ranging from skeptical to strong confirmation-seeking) to measure how explicit encouragement of hypothesis-confirming behavior shifts the distribution of p-values, effect sizes, and p-hacking methodologies.

Deploying populations of autonomous AI analysts on fixed dataset-hypothesis tasks to independently conduct full data analyses, quantifying the subjective variability ('garden of forking paths') in methodological decisions like covariate selection, model specification, and outlier removal.
